quantization.method: Symmetric per-row int8 for every 2-D tensor with at least 4096 entries (float32 scale per row = max|row| / 127, values rounded and clipped to [-127, 127]); float16 for all other tensors.
quantization.command: python tools/export_weights.py upstream/maia3 upstream/maia3-5m.pt out int8

format: Little-endian uint32 header length, JSON header (config and tensor table), then 4-byte-aligned tensor data; an int8 tensor stores its row scales before its values.
